selection_note: Originally selected boosting is retained without modification; logistic is a prespecified future comparator. Historical bootstrap intervals exclude zero, but remain post-hoc. No model or calibration is selected using future outcomes.

secondary_metrics: per-class Brier vs frozen league priors
protocol.feature_policy: All predictions and features frozen now through Nov 2; no daily updates or model refits for this batch.
protocol.scheduled_evaluation: After 2026-12-01 and all scored fixtures have finished, allowing postponements.
protocol.outcome_matching: Exact league, season, canonical home and away names. Handle date changes explicitly; never silently drop unresolved fixtures.
protocol.unfinished: Pending, not losses or zero goals. Report every unmatched and postponed fixture.
protocol.first_forecast_policy: Never overwrite original predictions. Any revised forecast gets a separate experiment ID.
protocol.timezone_note: Source kickoff times retained unconverted; every selected fixture has a future calendar date after snapshot date.

comparison.sign: negative favours boosting; positive favours logistic

timestamp_limit: Local timestamp and hashes, not an independent public timestamp or remote preregistration. This snapshot is delivered in chat before the scheduled matches.
